purpose: Cross-validates a full trade-document set (eBL, commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, insurance certificate) for internal consistency and computes a SHA-256 Merkle provenance root. Flags TBML red flags: over/under-invoicing, phantom shipments, mismatched goods/values (FATF typologies, ICC DSI KTDDE field model). Educational screen, not a SAR determination.
